blurb: Deep Cove Winery is a family-owned and operated winery located in North Saanich, British Columbia. Guests can enjoy handcrafted estate wines made from grapes grown on their vineyard and sourced from Okanagan and Osoyoos regions. The winery offers wine tastings, events, and venue rentals for weddings and private events.
